result.summary: The main visual defect is a broken image placeholder in the 'Popular right now' restaurant card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar, where a missing-image icon appears in a large empty gray block. The rest of the page renders correctly, with horizontal clipping of the 'Fastest near you' carousel treated as expected scroll behavior.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows a broken/missing image placeholder (a crossed-out image icon) instead of the restaurant's actual photo.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image loading so the restaurant's food/cover photo renders, and provide a proper fallback placeholder if the asset fails to load.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar row displays the '€0 delivery' badge as a large pill overlapping an empty gray image area, which looks disconnected from the actual item content below it.
issues.suggestion: Move the delivery-fee badge so it is anchored to the image or item content once the image loads, and ensure the placeholder area does not leave a large blank region.
